registers.name: REVISION_ID
registers.description: Implementation revision identifier readable by firmware.

fields.name: revision_id
fields.description: Implementation revision ID. Matches DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON register contract.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Primary control register for enable, mode, sequence seed, age limit, and timeout configuration.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Global enable for request launch and response-to-actuator flow.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Control mode used by request framing and response validation.

fields.name: slew_enable
fields.description: Enable bounded slew limiting in actuator command shaping.

fields.name: safe_selector
fields.description: Safe-state selector for documented policy selection and observability.

fields.name: reserved0
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: request_seq_seed
fields.description: Initial request identifier seed loaded into request framing state after reset or write.

fields.name: response_age_limit
fields.description: Maximum permitted response age in cycles/validations as implemented by the RTL.

fields.name: timeout_threshold
fields.description: Watchdog timeout threshold in cycles for an outstanding request.

registers.name: LIMITS_MIN
registers.description: Lower clamp limit for actuator command output.

fields.name: actuator_min
fields.description: Minimum clamp bound for the 32-bit actuator command output.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: LIMITS_MAX
registers.description: Upper clamp limit for actuator command output.

fields.name: actuator_max
fields.description: Maximum clamp bound for the 32-bit actuator command output.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: FAULT_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky fault status and encoded fault cause; write-one-to-clear applies to documented sticky fault bits only.

fields.name: fault_status
fields.description: Sticky fault indicator. Cleared only by documented write-one-to-clear behavior or reset policy.

fields.name: reserved0
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: fault_cause
fields.description: Encoded fault cause from safety supervision.

fields.name: reserved1
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: WATCHDOG_SNAPSHOT
registers.description: Firmware visibility into watchdog and request tracking state plus last accepted command snapshot.

fields.name: timeout_counter_snapshot
fields.description: Current watchdog counter snapshot.

fields.name: request_id_snapshot
fields.description: Current request identifier snapshot.

fields.name: last_good_cmd
fields.description: Last good actuator command snapshot accepted by the shaper.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Compact status register for software observability.

fields.name: safe_fallback
fields.description: Inhibit/status indication asserted during reset, fault, timeout, or host-unavailable conditions.

fields.name: fault_irq
fields.description: Fault interrupt mirror driven from the latched fault state.

fields.name: request_busy
fields.description: Outstanding request indication.

fields.name: validated_response_valid
fields.description: Most recent validated response strobe.

fields.name: actuator_cmd_valid
fields.description: Most recent actuator command validity status.

fields.name: status_snapshot_valid
fields.description: Status snapshot validity indication.
